references.text: Here Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun are mentioned as those who were to distribute the inheritance in the land of Canaan to the children of Israel, exactly as described in Joshua 14:1.
Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun, along with the heads of the fathers' houses in the tribes of Israel, are mentioned together as leaders responsible for distributing the land.

The conclusion of the land distribution confirms that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses in the tribes of Israel were responsible for the allocation of the inheritance.
The heads of the Levitical families came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun, and to the heads of the tribes, showing the same leadership structure.
The Lord gives instructions on how the land is to be distributed as an inheritance among the tribes of Israel, which forms the background for the distribution described in Joshua 14:1.
The Lord commands Joshua to distribute the land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh, which begins in chapter 14.
